# Project Name

One-sentence description of what this is and who it's for.

## Install

```sh
npm install
```

## Usage

```sh
npm run dev
```

## Scripts

| Script              | Purpose                                 |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `npm test`          | Run unit + integration tests            |
| `npm run lint`      | Run linters                             |
| `npm run check`     | Run all local quality gates in parallel |
| `npm run check:all` | Run the full pre-merge suite (slow)     |

## Contributing

See `CONTRIBUTING.md` if present. Otherwise: open an issue, branch from
`develop`, run `npm run check` before pushing.
